items.title: ENA unlock: 93,750,000 ENA (0.625% of supply) · Core contributors (30% of supply) + amount not published · Investors
items.summary: The page puts core contributors at 30% of ENA, locked on a one-year cliff at which 25% unlocks, then vesting monthly over three years, with schedules starting at the March 5, 2024 TGE. So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.

items.title: MORPHO: Founders (15.2% of supply): vesting ends; Strategic partners, cohort 3: vesting ends
items.summary: The docs say all co-founders relocked to a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from the earlier of the transferability date (November 21, 2024) or May 17, 2025. The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028. The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. The two official figures disagree, so no amount is shown.

headlines.title: Ether Slides Near $1,550, Down About 35% in Four Weeks
headlines.summary: Bitcoin lost about 31% over the same window, while declines in Solana, BNB and Hyperliquid underscored the broader selloff.

headlines.title: Sky TVL Falls 45% in a Week as USDC Reserve Shrinks
headlines.summary: Sky's tracked assets fell to $2.24 billion in the Nov. 20 daily snapshot. A large decline in its USDC conversion reserve corroborates the contraction.

headlines.title: Aave V4 Plan Would Put Idle USDC Into Circle Gateway
headlines.summary: New sweeps would have to keep Gateway exposure within 10 million USDC and 25% of supply, while preserving cash for withdrawals and loans.

headlines.title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
headlines.summary: The firm is the latest to join in building blockchain-based stock markets under the agency’s five-year "innovation exemption" for tokenized trading.

headlines.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
headlines.summary: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

headlines.title: Sky's USDC Exit Reserve Rises 29% to 1.13 Billion
headlines.summary: The shared USDS and DAI conversion reserve gained 254 million USDC between midday snapshots, but remained well below its level at the start of Nov. 19.

headlines.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
headlines.summary: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

headlines.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
headlines.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

headlines.title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
headlines.summary: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

headlines.title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
headlines.summary: The ECB president called for common rules as the EU's new blockchain settlement system handled a 1 billion-euro ($1.1 billion) digital bond transaction.

headlines.title: MoonPay Applies for National Trust Bank Charter to Grow Custody and Stablecoin Business
headlines.summary: The crypto payments firm joins a rush of crypto companies seeking federal trust charters, which face growing political scrutiny.

headlines.title: MoonPay applies for national trust bank charter to expand stablecoin services
headlines.summary: MoonPay has applied for a national trust bank charter to expand its custody and stablecoin services under federal oversight.

headlines.title: CryptoUK Urges FCA Not to Treat DeFi Devs as Regulated by Default
headlines.summary: The UK crypto trade group broadly backed the regulator's proposed perimeter guidance, but warned that parts of it go further than the law.

headlines.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
headlines.summary: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

headlines.title: Wrapped Monero token plunges 99% as issuer-linked wallet sells $13.5 million
headlines.summary: The sell-off hit Wagyu’s XMR1 token, separate from Monero and Hyperliquid’s XMR futures market.

headlines.title: Anthropic Ends Debut Up 17% as Ondo Launches ANTon
headlines.summary: Ondo announced that ANTon was live for minting and redemption, while Binance scheduled a shift from pre-IPO futures pricing to a stock-linked contract.

headlines.title: Anthropic shares may fall 5% at Friday’s open, crypto futures suggest
headlines.summary: About $1.7 billion traded through a Hyperliquid contract on the AI company’s shares in 24 hours, and the biggest position heading into Friday’s Nasdaq open is a $30 million short.

headlines.title: CFTC Chair on Hyperliquid and onchain venues, Ripple CLO doubts Elizabeth Warren will set crypto policy, and more
headlines.summary: In today's newsletter, CFTC Chair Selig outlines how Hyperliquid and other onchain venues could enter the US; Ripple's Alderoty doubts Elizabeth Warren will set US crypto policy; and more.

headlines.title: Sky Council Plans Extra Buybacks After SKY Price Slump
headlines.summary: The Council’s seven-day plan adds 750,000 USDS in daily buybacks and is designed to keep the daily USDS allocation for staking rewards roughly steady.

headlines.title: Sky’s USDS Circulating Supply Falls 39% in One Day
headlines.summary: DefiLlama’s daily readings show roughly 2 billion fewer USDS in circulation. One Ethereum swap burned 400 million USDS and paid the sender USDC.

headlines.title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
headlines.summary: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.

headlines.title: Wallet Tied to Rune Christensen Owes Half of Sky's Fully Borrowed Lending Pool
headlines.summary: Liquidations for the collateral type are switched off, and the 2.5-cent price cap that governs those loans was proposed by Christensen in a forum post last year

headlines.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
headlines.summary: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

headlines.title: Hyperliquid Anthropic futures priced within 1% of Nasdaq opening price
headlines.summary: Hyperliquid traders priced Anthropic futures within 1% of the stock’s Nasdaq opening price, as trading surged ahead of the AI company’s IPO.

headlines.title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
headlines.summary: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.

headlines.title: Binance.US Says Perps Bid Clears CFTC Completeness Check
headlines.summary: The exchange seeks trading and clearing registrations for a US derivatives offering. Neither has been approved, and Binance.US says it offers no derivatives yet.

headlines.title: Anthropic Perp Tops $1.4 Billion in 24-Hour Volume
headlines.summary: Trade.xyz's ANT contract had about $283 million in open interest, with its mark price within 0.2% of Anthropic's Nasdaq-listed share price in a matched-minute comparison.

headlines.title: US Crypto Perps: Coinbase and Kraken Access Explained
headlines.summary: Both advertise US access through futures brokers. Their public disclosures distinguish domestic accounts from global services, with separate approval checks.

headlines.title: Sky Raises stUSDS Yield to 24.74%; App Shows $0 Liquidity
headlines.summary: A borrower repaid about 414,000 USDS, and a bot contract redeemed stUSDS in the next transaction. Both preceded the rate increase. A later app snapshot showed no withdrawal liquidity.

headlines.title: CFTC Chair Selig outlines how Hyperliquid and other onchain venues could enter the US
headlines.summary: Michael Selig said platforms like Hyperliquid have two ways to enter the U.S. retail market and must follow the same rules as other exchanges
